matching_guidance.contextual: Never identify solely from this term. Require independent sport/competition evidence in the EPG programme title or descriptive text; do not blindly trust existing sport classification.
rules: Search canonical display names and synonyms at each level, but treat any contextual synonym as a candidate only, not a confirmed match.
Do not propagate a sport/category alias into all child competitions.
Prefer exact phrase and whole-token matching over substring matching.
Normalize case, whitespace, hyphen punctuation and diacritics (retain original display labels).
Do not treat generic words such as World Cup, Championship, Test, Rugby, Football or Premier League as unique.
Disambiguate duplicate aliases across sibling branches and sports; if no reliable evidence, display only the last confirmed ancestor.
Do not trust IPTV source sport labels as sole contextual evidence.
Do not classify based purely on team names unless a separate team-to-sport/competition database and season information exists.
